title: EnemiesFile
description: Enemy categories and solutions (design doc 5.5). Cross-checks (solution references, which fields each category may have, Tiled object classes) are in core/combat/enemies.ts.

object.description: Tiled object class that carries this solution in a map, e.g. Bed for sleep.

solution.description: Key into solutions; required for reforming and immune enemies, absent for defeatable ones.

archetype.description: One of the five shared behaviours of design doc 5.3.

performance.description: Hits to close the case; defeatable enemies only.

clings.description: Drifts toward the operator and clings on contact, one slow stack each (design doc 5.5); reforming enemies only.

boss.description: Id of the file in content/bosses that runs this enemy; its budget replaces performance and its moves replace an archetype.
